Shadow DOM Security Test (Issue #197)

This page tests that the Aletheia overlay's Shadow DOM is properly closed per ADR 0202.

Test: Host Page Cannot Access Shadow Root

Select this text to trigger the Aletheia overlay. After the overlay appears, this page will attempt to access its shadowRoot. With mode: 'closed', this should return null.

Test not run yet. Trigger the Aletheia overlay first.

How this test works:

  1. User (or automation) selects text to trigger Aletheia
  2. The page's JavaScript polls for the overlay host element
  3. Once found, it attempts to access element.shadowRoot
  4. With mode: 'closed', this returns null (PASS)
  5. With mode: 'open', this would return the ShadowRoot (FAIL)
